name: Omega Redux
detailed_description:
"Just one hour. Just one task: E.R.E. — Explore, Retrieve, Escape. Doesn’t sound too hard… unless you’re trying to find a relic hunter. Nobody wants to go there for your stupid stuff! But I will."

OMEGA REDUX is an episodic adventure with exploration elements, where you play as a relic hunter and his techno-octopus companion. Dive into doomed worlds exactly 60 minutes before their total annihilation—and race against time to escape with a priceless artifact and complete your mission.

IN EACH EPISODE, YOU WILL:

  • Track down a bizarre artifact requested by passionate collectors of oddities.

  • Discover and enjoy unique vehicles—from a horse and sports car to a helicopter and hot air balloon—each tailored to the episode’s setting.

  • Explore an open world filled with secrets and the final stories of people doomed by an impending apocalypse.

  • Escape just before disaster strikes to survive, complete your mission, and deliver the artifact to the client.

GAME FEATURES

  • Apocalyptic Setting

A sci-fi journey through colossal disasters that blur the line between awe and terror—an experience you can live through, both literally and figuratively, only in a video game.

  • Cinematic Finales

Witness realistic and epic apocalyptic events: a falling mega-Earth, an approaching insatiable black hole, terrifying nuclear blasts, or a mile-high tsunami.

  • Open-World Exploration

Diverse open-world maps with multiple paths and no two episodes alike. Played in both first- and third-person, you’ll travel from peaceful mountain towns to perilous jungles on the far side of the universe.

  • Robot Companion Interaction

Switch perspectives to play as the robot for artifact scanning and environmental analysis, or interact with it as the relic hunter. Work together to solve puzzles that require both characters.

  • Variety of Vehicles and Mounts

In each episode, unlock special vehicles and mounts that help you explore locations faster and more efficiently.

  • Immersive Side Quests

Collect hidden items, uncover lore unique to each world, and explore its most intriguing points of interest.

  • A timed session

Each episode is a replayable, time-limited adventure where every second counts. Estimated playtime is approximately 1 hour per episode. Four episodes are currently planned.

WHO IT'S FOR

Perfect for players who love exploring extraordinary worlds, teaming up with a cute robot, and experiencing breathtaking destruction rarely seen in games or films.

short_description: An episodic sci-fi adventure where you explore doomed open worlds one hour before their destruction. As a relic hunter and his playable robot companion, search for strangely meaningful artifacts while cinematic catastrophe approaches with every passing second. Get out in time—or meet the end!
supported_languages: English, Russian, Spanish - Spain, Simplified Chinese, Japanese, Spanish - Latin America

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 or AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 660 or AMD Radeon HD 7850
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 30 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: System requirements are preliminary and may change closer to release.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 or 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-10700K or AMD Ryzen 7 3700X
  • Memory: 32 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 or AMD Radeon RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 30 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: System requirements are preliminary and may change closer to release.
